shared_elements: upright standing stone slab/pillar carved in relief
animal or creature heads in profile within the design
loose rubble/stone at the base of the monument
monument shown in situ within a landscape
justification: Both show a tall, free-standing rectangular stone carved with vertically stacked registers of figural imagery and photographed/drawn in situ amid rubble, which gives an immediate formal echo. But the carving manner is quite different: A is sparse, shallow, flat-relief with isolated animal silhouettes on empty ground, while B is dense, deeply undercut high relief filling every inch around a frontal anthropomorphic figure, and no specific motif recurs in both.
